integrity: The proof is self-contained; independent graph-cycle finite enumeration and an explicit online decision-tree witness are supplied as reproducibility checks, not as infinite certificates. No assertion of absolute publication priority or independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: The exact online dimension is proved only for powers-of-two ladder lengths and n=2,3,4,5; two-sided logarithmic bounds cover other lengths. There is no independent mathematical audit. An alternative interval-hypergraph statement or a source with unavailable full text could affect priority.
title: Cycle-incidence shattering on ladders: missing pairs and dyadic online growth
